standard.summary: CPU 侧 pinned 缓冲，加速 H2D
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: A pinned buffer on the CPU side to speed up H2D
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: CPU 侧 pinned 缓冲，加速 H2D（真机吞吐关键）。Windows 上可能抬高 shared GPU / 系统 RAM；内存紧张可关。

advanced_en.principle: CPU-side pinned buffers that speed up H2D copies (key to real-machine throughput). On Windows this can raise shared GPU / system RAM; turn it off if memory is tight.
